_about: How tools/nowplaying treats each HEOS source. Rules are tried in turn and the first that matches wins: sid is the HEOS source number, mid_prefix the start of the media id (inputs are 'inputs/<name>'), type 'song' or 'station'.

Behaviours: album (show the cover), radio (station art if there is any), record (the record planet, no cover needed), disc (a CD: no cover or progress expected, keeps the current colours), default (show whatever there is), release (give the dome back after release_seconds), off (leave the dome alone).
label: what an input is called on the dome, in place of the amp's own '<player> - Coaxial In'.
audio_means_playing: for inputs where the amp cannot tell if music is playing (a turntable), sound from the WLED audio sync counts as playing.
while_showing: settings a scene takes while the music has the dome (Music uses theme 8, album: the cover's colours); the old values come back when it hands back.
Your own changes: copy this file, edit it, and pass it with --config.
